questions_for_human: BLOCKER RESOLUTION PATH: The slackChannelId omission in Prepare User Data is a live n8n bug introduced before this sprint (the node predates the sprint; Build WF-01 Envelope assumed camelCase mapping was complete). The fix is a single-line addition to the existing Prepare User Data jsCode. Should this be applied as an inline hotfix before the WF-02 entry guard (sub-8) runs in testing — since WF-02's guard validates the envelope and a null slack_channel_id would pass guard but silently corrupt every consult-channel leaf?

OPTED-OUT ENVELOPE: The Build WF-01 Envelope (Opted-Out) node intentionally sets user:null. WF-21 is called on this path. Does WF-21 require user.slack_channel_id or user.id from the envelope, or does it create a fresh user and can safely receive user:null? If WF-21 needs any user fields from the envelope, a second SELECT would be needed inside Build WF-01 Envelope (Opted-Out) — or user fields could be backfilled from Lookup: Blacklisted Users output (which provides id/phone_number/status/blocked_reason).
